# Coverage residual

*Generated by `scripts/gen-coverage-justification.py`. Do not edit.*

The **1278** statements in the certified item that the measured runs did not reach, sorted into the categories DO-178C table A-7 asks about. Measured on x86_64, debug profile.

| Category | Statements | Share |
|---|---:|---:|
| Unreachable on the measured architecture | 65 | 5% |
| Reached only when the kernel is stopping | 38 | 3% |
| Hardware the measured machine does not have | 121 | 9% |
| Needs a test | 1054 | 82% |

**103 are argued, 1054 are a gap**, and the remainder is a statement about which machine was measured rather than either.

---

## Unreachable on the measured architecture — 65 statements

Justified. These statements belong to another architecture or another board, and no run on x86_64 can reach them. The same code is ordinary covered code where it belongs, so this justification is per configuration and the other architectures owe their own.

| Statements | Ring | File |
|---:|---|---|
| 65 | `core` | `iommu/smmuv3.rs` |

---

## Reached only when the kernel is stopping — 38 statements

Justified. The panic report, its catalogue and the backtrace walker run when the kernel has already decided to stop. Exercising them means crashing deliberately, which the boot gates do not do -- and a passing run that reached them would be a failing run.

| Statements | Ring | File |
|---:|---|---|
| 24 | `core` | `panic.rs` |
| 12 | `core` | `panic/screen.rs` |
| 2 | `core` | `backtrace.rs` |

---

## Hardware the measured machine does not have — 121 statements

**Not a justification, a configuration statement.** Enumeration and setup for devices this QEMU invocation does not present. A different machine would reach some of it, so the honest closure is either to measure on a machine that has the hardware or to state which devices the claim excludes.

## What this does not do

It sorts by file, not by statement. A file in *needs-a-test* may hold individual lines that are genuinely unreachable -- a defensive `else` on an invariant the type system already forces -- and a file in a justified category may hold a line that is not. Closing F-10 means walking the fourth category line by line; this says which lines to walk and which not to bother with, which is the part a percentage could not.
